entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Goddess formed by fusing Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; mother of the three numena; eventually stabbed with the Mirari sword.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Druid who follows Karona and retrieves the Mirari sword; brother of Jeska.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: One of the three beings fused into Karona; mother of Lowallyn.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: One of the beings fused into Karona; mother of Kuberr; Jeska in her earlier stage.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: One of the beings fused into Karona; mother of Averru.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: Trapped under rubble, he enlists in the city guard and later fights at Averru.

entities.name: Sash
entities.description: With Waistcoat, became corporeal and was appointed Karona's prophet; helps stab her with the Mirari sword.

entities.name: Waistcoat
entities.description: With Sash, became corporeal and was appointed Karona's prophet.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: Ghost of Kamahl's mentor, a dwarf who guides him through the Gorgon Mound; slain again by Kamahl.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Former Mer ambassador, now a giant zombie pinned by the Mirari sword; Kamahl's old nemesis.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Found weeping beside Nivea in a deathwurm; reemerges as Lowallyn, the third numen.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Third numen who gave Ixidor his powers; son of Karona and Akroma.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: A numen and teenager who calls Karona mother; son of Phage.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: The last numen, who is the city itself; son of Zagorka.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: Leader of Kuberr's contingent, buried alive by Karona.

entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: Her remains lie in the deathwurm beside Ixidor.

entities.name: Lord Macht
entities.description: Warden of a metal world who is really Karn, Urza's golem, a planeswalker.

entities.name: Argentum
entities.description: Lord Macht's metal plane.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: A probe sent by the plane's creator to learn about life on Dominaria, made too powerful; also the sword used to slay Karona.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The continent torn by Karona's worship.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: City annihilated by Karona.

entities.name: Eroshia
entities.description: City Karona and her prophets reach.

entities.name: Gorgon Mound
entities.description: A hill of brambles and trees in the Krosan forest formed around the Mirari.

entities.name: The Numena
entities.description: Three sons of Karona, mother of magic, who wished to destroy her.

events.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper fuses Akroma, Phage and Zagorka into the goddess Karona; the armies stop fighting to worship her.
events.quote: Kamahl's Soul Reaper has cut through Akroma , Phage , and Zagorka to fuse them into one being: the goddess Karona.

events.summary: Kamahl sees the carnage of Karona's worshipers and resolves that Otaria needs no goddess; he goes to Krosa for the Mirari sword.
events.quote: Kamahl sees the carnage and her callousness and resolves that Otaria needs no goddess.

events.summary: Karona finds Sash and Waistcoat and appoints them her prophets.
events.quote: She provides them with everything they need and appoints them to be her prophets

events.summary: Kamahl, guided by Balthor's ghost, retrieves his sword from Laquatus's corpse and defeats the giant Laquatus again.
events.quote: Kamahl has to defeat his old nemesis again

events.summary: Karona creates a chasm that swallows the rampaging armies, burying them, including Braids, alive.
events.quote: she creates a vast chasm underneath the armies that swallows them whole and then fills it again, burying them, including Braids, alive.

events.summary: Kamahl masters the Mirari only by slaying Balthor's phantom in a rage.
events.quote: a feat which is accomplished only when he slays the phantom in a fit of rage

events.summary: Kamahl rescues Ixidor from the deathwurm; Ixidor reemerges as Lowallyn, the third numen.
events.quote: Ixador reemerges as Lowallyn, the third numen, who had given Ixidor his powers

events.summary: Karona embraces her destiny as a goddess and builds an army to destroy those who oppose her.
events.quote: She decides to embrace her destiny as a goddess and builds an army of followers to destroy the few that oppose her.

events.summary: Karona annihilates the city of Aphetto while Lowallyn and Kamahl escape through a portal.
events.quote: just before she annihilates the city in the blink of an eye

events.summary: The three numena set a trap with Kamahl to seal Karona, but he stops it, allowing her to escape the plane.
events.quote: He stops the plan at the last moment, allowing Karona, with Sash and Waistcoat in tow, to escape the plane.

events.summary: Karona meets Lord Macht, warden of a metal world, who reveals the Mirari's nature; she realizes he is its creator.
events.quote: Karona is not fooled by his story and realizes that he is the creator and that he feels guilty about the Mirari.

events.summary: Karona returns with an army and overcomes the defenders at Averru, killing the numena and taking the Mirari sword.
events.quote: The numena are killed, and only Kamahl stands with the Mirari sword.

events.summary: Sash and Waistcoat recover the blade and drive it through Karona on Lord Macht's instruction.
events.quote: Sash, and Waistcoat recover the blade and drive it through her

events.summary: Lord Macht takes Karona to Argentum, where she regresses to Jeska, and reveals himself as Karn; he gives life to the Mirari to create a new warden and leaves with Jeska.
events.quote: he reveals himself to be none other than Karn , Urza 's golem

relations.quote: Kamahl bids a last farewell to his sister
the ghost of his mentor Balthor
The three are sons of Karona, mother of magic
appoints them to be her prophets

relations.note: Revealed as the creator of the plane and the Mirari
relations.quote: Karona is not fooled by his story and realizes that he is the creator
